workshoptitle: Connected Student Support with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Meet Seer Higher Education and the teams coordinating student-support operations.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Student-Support Query
tutorials.description: Combine request records, semantic search, JSON details, and campus-service locations in one query.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Model Student-Support Requests as JSON
tutorials.description: Compare JSON columns, JSON collections, and JSON Relational Duality for an application workflow.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Find Support Resources with AI Vector Search
tutorials.description: Rank support resources by meaning and join them to linked open requests.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Explore the Student-Support Network
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Property Graph and SQL/PGQ to examine student, course, advisor, and service relationships.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Plan Campus Support with Oracle Spatial
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Spatial to find support sites near campus demand areas and request locations.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Forecast Student-Support Demand with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Train a classifier on synthetic workload examples and score an illustrative next-term scenario.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Student-Success Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Generate SQL from natural-language questions over approved Higher Education views.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Student-Support Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Create a read-only agent that uses an approved SQL tool and records its activity.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding of the workshop's Oracle Database capabilities.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
